# nat-gateways

NAT gateways give instances without a public address outbound access to the internet.

## GET /v1/nat-gateways

Operation `nat_gateway_list`.

`GET /v1/nat-gateways?vpc=<uuid>`. Paginated per convention 3: `limit` (default 50, capped at 500), `page_token`, and `sort_by`. Only `id_ascending` is accepted, because `nat_gateway/in_vpc/` is keyed by the gateway id.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single project. |
| `tenant` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to a single tenant. |
| `vpc` | query | no | string (uuid) | Restrict to NAT gateways in this VPC. Required. |
| `limit` | query | no | integer (uint32) | Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50 and is clamped to 500; zero is rejected rather than treated as "default". |
| `page_token` | query | no | string | Opaque cursor from the previous response's `next_page`. Valid only for the query that produced it. A token replayed against a different selector set or sort order, or modified in any way, is a `400`; it never silently restarts the listing. |
| `sort_by` | query | no | [NameOrIdSortMode](schemas.md#nameoridsortmode) | Order the collection is walked in. Defaults to `id_ascending`. Bound into the cursor, so it cannot change part-way through a walk. |

Responses:

- `200`: successful operation, `application/json`: [ResultsPage_for_NatGateway](schemas.md#resultspage_for_natgateway)
- `4XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)
- `5XX`: [Error](schemas.md#error)

## DELETE /v1/nat-gateways/{nat_gateway_id}

Operation `nat_gateway_delete`.

`DELETE /v1/nat-gateways/{nat_gateway_id}`. Refused with `409` while a route still targets the gateway. Answers `202` with the gateway as it was; it is gone, and reads answer `404`, once the platform has released it.

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nat_gateway_id` | path | yes | string (uuid) |  |
